001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.json.encoder;
002
003import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogConfig;
004import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogEncoder;
005import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogEncoder.EncoderProvider;
006import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProvider;
007import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProviderRef;
008import io.jstach.rainbowgum.spi.RainbowGumServiceProvider;
009import io.jstach.rainbowgum.spi.RainbowGumServiceProvider.Configurator;
010import io.jstach.svc.ServiceProvider;
011
012/**
013 * Adds
014 * <a href="https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/ecs-logging/java/current/index.html">Elastic
015 * Common Schema (ECS)</a> JSON Encoder to encoder registry with
016 * {@value EcsEncoder#ECS_SCHEME} URI scheme.
017 */
018@ServiceProvider(RainbowGumServiceProvider.class)
019public class EcsEncoderConfigurator implements Configurator {
020
021        /**
022         * Default constructor for service loader.
023         */
024        public EcsEncoderConfigurator() {
025        }
026
027        @Override
028        public boolean configure(LogConfig config, Pass pass) {
029                config.encoderRegistry().register(EcsEncoder.ECS_SCHEME, new EcsEncoderProvider());
030                return true;
031        }
032
033        private static class EcsEncoderProvider implements EncoderProvider {
034
035                @Override
036                public LogProvider<LogEncoder> provide(LogProviderRef ref) {
037                        return (name, c) -> {
038                                EcsEncoderBuilder b = new EcsEncoderBuilder(name);
039                                b.fromProperties(c.properties(), ref);
040                                return b.build();
041                        };
042                }
043
044        }
045
046}
